Tap a picture to see it big. These are screenshots and photos from the VIP Events site itself, so you can check how it looks without leaving this page.

What's on the site

  • Event lighting & sound for special celebrations, elegant business meetings, private parties and relaxed home events.
  • The Lighting Lab — slide through colors and watch the event photos re-light.
  • A “Book your date” panel — pick a lighting color and event type, enter a ZIP code and a date, and send a booking request to be confirmed.
  • A photo gallery, “Nights we love to build”, and a “See the lights in motion” video section.
  • Rental gear and a party-supplies shop.
